b: I've had a hell of a last month and have been going through a terrible bout of heightened anxiety. I have experience being on benzos and have been on them off and on the last fifteen years. I will say that I am super hesitant to take them because of how well it works and I try to push through my panic attacks with my self soothing techniques but I recently got a prescription for Ativan and I haven't had to take it and my anxiety is better just because I know I have that option as a last resort. Has anyone else experienced this?
